description: Source code defining the CKEDITOR.dom.range class, implementing DOM range operations such as clone, collapse, insert, split, and boundary checks within the CKEditor rich text editor.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.range
classes.description: Class implementing DOM range operations for CKEditor.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the range object.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses the range to its start or end point.

methods.name: cloneContents
methods.description: Clones the contents within the range into a document fragment.

methods.name: deleteContents
methods.description: Deletes the contents within the range from the DOM.

methods.name: extractContents
methods.description: Extracts and removes the contents within the range into a document fragment.

methods.name: createBookmark
methods.description: Creates a bookmark to restore the range later, including DOM nodes.

methods.name: createBookmark2
methods.description: Creates a normalized, mutation-sensible bookmark.

methods.name: moveToBookmark
methods.description: Restores the range from a bookmark.

methods.name: getBoundaryNodes
methods.description: Returns the boundary nodes of the range.

methods.name: getCommonAncestor
methods.description: Finds the common ancestor node of the range boundaries.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Transforms range boundaries from text nodes to element nodes where possible.

methods.name: optimizeBookmark
methods.description: Adjusts range boundaries out of bookmark nodes.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace or empty nodes from range boundaries.

methods.name: enlarge
methods.description: Enlarges the range boundaries to include more content based on specified units.

methods.name: shrink
methods.description: Shrinks the range to the innermost nodes or elements.

methods.name: insertNode
methods.description: Inserts a node at the start of the range.

methods.name: moveToPosition
methods.description: Moves the range to a specific position relative to a node.

methods.name: selectNodeContents
methods.description: Selects the entire contents of a node.

methods.name: setStart
methods.description: Sets the start boundary of the range.

methods.name: setEnd
methods.description: Sets the end boundary of the range.

methods.name: setStartAfter
methods.description: Sets the start boundary after a specified node.

methods.name: setStartBefore
methods.description: Sets the start boundary before a specified node.

methods.name: setEndAfter
methods.description: Sets the end boundary after a specified node.

methods.name: setEndBefore
methods.description: Sets the end boundary before a specified node.

methods.name: setStartAt
methods.description: Sets the start boundary at a specific position within a node.

methods.name: setEndAt
methods.description: Sets the end boundary at a specific position within a node.

methods.name: fixBlock
methods.description: Fixes block boundaries within the range.

methods.name: splitBlock
methods.description: Splits a block element at the range boundaries.

methods.name: splitElement
methods.description: Splits an element at the range position.

methods.name: checkBoundaryOfElement
methods.description: Checks if a range boundary is at the inner boundary of an element.

methods.name: checkStartOfBlock
methods.description: Checks if the range starts at the beginning of a block.

methods.name: checkEndOfBlock
methods.description: Checks if the range ends at the end of a block.

methods.name: moveToElementEditablePosition
methods.description: Moves the range to the editable position inside an element.
